analogy.rationale: HPRT1, IMPDH1 and PPAT are purine nucleotide biosynthesis enzymes, so inhibiting them depletes guanine/adenine nucleotides and impairs DNA/RNA synthesis, mimicking other antimetabolite blocks of nucleotide supply such as DHFR, ribonucleotide reductase and thymidylate synthase inhibition. The response should be moderate because these enzymes are broadly expressed and the resulting nucleotide stress affects proliferation and nucleic acid synthesis programs.
